name: NIPPON SANSO INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
india_angle: Nippon Sanso India Pvt. Ltd. operates in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, indicating a strategic presence in the Indian market.
summary: Nippon Sanso India Private Limited is part of the Nippon Sanso Holdings Group, a major supplier of industrial and electronics gases. They provide critical gases used in semiconductor manufacturing processes, supporting various segments such as logic and memory. Their operations span across multiple regions, including a significant presence in India.
